department: Department of Earth System Science (Doerr School of Sustainability)

deadline.value: Apply by 5:00pm Pacific, December 1, 2026 (earlier than the usual 11:59pm).
deadline.quote: Applications to Earth System Science graduate programs must be received by the deadline of Tuesday, December 1, 2026, at 5:00 pm Pacific Time

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

gre_general.value: The GRE General is optional; submit it only if it helps your case after talking to a potential advisor.
gre_general.quote: The general GRE test is optional.

toefl_min.value: ESS asks for TOEFL iBT 100 minimum (IELTS 7), unless you are exempt through an English-medium degree.
toefl_min.quote: Your minimum score must be 100 (internet-based) OR 600 (paper-based).

supervisor.value: You are admitted to work with a specific faculty member and there are no rotations, so contact potential advisors before applying and name them in your application.
supervisor.quote: Students are admitted to our graduate program specifically to work with an individual faculty member (or two, if co-advised). | There is no rotation program in the first year. | contact individual faculty members to inquire about their research and discuss your background and goals

funding.value: Generally all ESS PhD students get full support for five years (tuition plus a $15,125 quarterly stipend in 2026-27).
funding.quote: Generally, all Ph.D. candidates within ESS are provided full financial support for the first five years.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree (or international equivalent) is the minimum requirement.
entry_route.quote: You must hold, or expect to hold before enrollment at Stanford, a U.S. bachelor’s degree or its international equivalent from a college or university of recognized standing.

notes: Also relevant: the Environment and Resources (E-IPER) PhD, which is not covered here.
